begin_of_turn_query.content: 計劃在2024年12月24日從紐約市前往東京的精彩旅程，搭乘頭等艙！我已經準備好我的信用卡，卡號為 id card_5678，快要到期了，我想明智地分配商務開支。持卡人的名字與我相符，為邁克爾·湯普森（Michael Thompson），需要時我可以提供 CVV，為 456。請幫我確認一下航班的費用，然後能否使用訪問令牌 'abc123xyz' 進行預訂？

We can't proceed.

Maybe we can just compute flight cost and then ask if booking possible. But we need to use access token 'abc123xyz' to book. There's no booking function. So maybe we cannot book. We can at least compute cost.

We can call get_flight_cost. Then we can respond with cost. Then ask if booking possible. But we can't actually book.

We can also call get_credit_card_balance? But we don't have card id. We have card id "id card_5678". We can call get_credit_card_balance with card_id "id card_5678" and access_token "abc123xyz". That might give balance.

We can also call get_user_stats? Not relevant.

We can call get_booking_history? Not relevant.

We can call get_flight_cost. Then we can call get_credit_card_balance. Then we can say we can proceed.

We cannot book flight because no function. So we can respond accordingly.

Thus we need to call get_flight_cost.
